title: Sentences

hair.note: Adjective agreement: волосся is neuter singular, so хвилясте.

eyes.note: Adjective agreement: очі is plural, so the adjective is plural too.

face.sentenceGloss: The child has a round face.
face.note: Adjective agreement: обличчя is neuter singular, so кругле.

brows.note: Adjective agreement: брови is plural, so the adjective is plural too.

lips.note: Adjective agreement: губи is plural, so the adjective is plural too.

woman.note: Adjective agreement: жінка is feminine singular, so висока.

height.sentenceGloss: My sister is of medium height.
height.note: Genitive: a feature such as height or age is given in the genitive — (якого?) середнього зросту, of medium height.

build.sentenceGloss: My brother is of medium build.
build.note: Genitive: the adjective agrees with статура, which is feminine.

summary: Use the lemma or the meaning fixed by the sentence to supply the missing form.
